description: This file defines an Akka actor class `RetrieveConnectionLogsAggregatorActor` used for aggregating connection log responses in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages multiple responses, handles timeouts, and restricts log size before sending the combined result back to the requester.

classes.name: RetrieveConnectionLogsAggregatorActor
classes.description: An Akka actor for aggregating multiple `RetrieveConnectionLogsResponse` messages, handling timeouts, and limiting log size before responding.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props configuration for instantiating the actor.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling behavior for the actor, including response handling, timeout, and default logging.

methods.name: handleReceiveTimeout
methods.description: Handles the timeout scenario, sending a timeout exception if no response was received, or the aggregated response if available.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Initial setup to set receive timeout.

methods.name: handleRetrieveConnectionLogsResponse
methods.description: Processes incoming `RetrieveConnectionLogsResponse` messages, merging responses until all expected responses are received.

methods.name: sendResponse
methods.description: Sends the aggregated and possibly truncated response back to the original sender.

methods.name: restrictMaxLogEntriesLength
methods.description: Limits the size of log entries to fit within the maximum specified byte size by dropping oldest logs.
